text: Transportation Services is requesting approval to amend traffic regulations on Beaty Avenue and on Dowling Avenue, between Queen Street West and King Street West to address operational and parking changes. The proposed changes would facilitate the installation of a quiet street cycling route that was identified for this neighbourhood as part of the Ten Year Cycling Network Plan. This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Enacted the amendments outlined in Attachment 2 to the report (July 4, 2018) from the Acting Director, Transportation Infrastructure Management.
